patterns.desc: CORE money formula: transfer is credit-card revenue minus outcomes
the bank transfer is the raw transfer amount — no ÷1.18 for exempt stores, whose prices carry no VAT (must stay in step with totalForInvoice in routes/hyp.js)
commission is charged on the FINAL items price charged — productDiscounts must NOT be added back here (owner decision 2026-08-04), while reimbursed coupons, Shoofi compensations and drive-in stay in
card revenue is the price actually charged, not the pre-discount list price
drive-in is INSIDE the commission base and is read with this fallback chain — older orders carry only the nested driveInPricing form

shippingPrice is the COURIER's money (effectiveDeliveryFee) and is OUTSIDE the store commission base — if this moves into routes/payments/admin.js's revenue build, the base and every report on it is wrong
order.total is built from orderPrice + shippingPrice + driveIn − coupon − coins, so it is never a commission base — reports must sum orderPrice + driveIn instead
cash-vs-card driver payout branch

CORE invariant 7: the store is billed a coupon's nominal storeDiscount whenever it is not customer-specific and not full_discount — the gate is blind to discountType, so a delivery coupon lands here too

CORE invariant 7: a percentage-type coupon bills the store a percentage of the ITEMS subtotal even when its discountType is 'delivery' — couponDeliverySplit deliberately diverges and takes the share off order.shippingPrice instead (owner ruling 2026-08-12)

CORE invariant 7: couponsFromShoofi credits the discount APPLIED on the order, capped by Shoofi's share — never the coupon's nominal value per redemption (a partial-use coupon was credited in full at every store; owner decision 2026-10)
stores-export-new routes the customer-specific order_items credit through shoofiCouponCredit with the order's applied amount

CORE invariant 7: an empty shoofiDiscount on a customer-specific coupon falls back to coupon.value — INTENTIONAL, it credits back a store-paid COMP-* compensation coupon against its one-time compensationsToCustomers charge
MASAV DOS-Hebrew encoding
deleting a report releases its carry-over compensations back to pending, so the regenerated report re-bills them
store→Shoofi compensations (compensationFor 'shoofi') are an OUTCOME inside totalOutcomes — never credited back, never a coupon
every term of totalOutcomes must be a BILLING_COMPONENT, or the dashboard's reconciliation delta lies
the live overview runs the store report ENGINE over the range — it must never re-derive settlement math
delivery-fee population is the settlement one (delivered, not delivery-only), not the dashboard's completedAt
CORE invariant 9: the overview's store candidates are every non-mock store, not the live-today registry (getLiveStores dropped hidden stores that were still owed money)
CORE invariant 9: inclusion is decided on the engine output (not all zeros), with contract charges counting only for live stores

CORE invariant 3 (combo note): a line's originalPrice adds the extras portion undiscounted — for a combo that is surcharges + nested extras, and the customer-facing combo 'savings' is never part of it, so it never becomes a productDiscount
CORE invariant 3: productDiscount is derived from the order's own originalOrderPrice vs charged price — nothing else (not a combo's display savings) feeds it
movein records are separated by an EMPTY line — byte-tested against the accountant's own export
stores-tab accounts (50001 revenue / 40002 output VAT) are the accountant's, proven by their export — never guess them
drivers-tab accounts are unknown until the accountant supplies them; the export refuses (422 missing-config) meanwhile — when they land, update reference §7b
the accountant's Hashavshevet export endpoint (reference §7b)
a missing/invalid מספר תיק SKIPS the document (listed, re-downloadable via docs=) — it does not block the file (owner decision 2026-09-29); reference §7b

CORE invariant 5: the compensations-approved guard queries createdAt (a BSON Date) with Date bounds over the report's own compensation window — the old string bounds matched nothing and the guard never fired

CORE invariant 10: the store report reads compensations over exact [start, next period start) bounds — without the flag the list endpoint stretches the end to 23:59:59 and the 1st of the next month is billed twice
CORE invariant 10: a period's compensation window ends exactly where the next period's starts (same function), so consecutive reports tile with no overlap and no gap
CORE invariant 10: only the report's self-call gets exact exclusive bounds; the admin date filter keeps end-of-day stretching
CORE invariant 10: deleting a compensation is refused once a report covering its createdAt exists (add/edit/approve-item are locked by the same helper)

the MASAV file and the admin preview resolve Excel columns with ONE shared recogniser (mirrored at shoofi-delivery-web src/utils/masav-columns.ts) - two recognisers is how a green 109-row preview became 109 copies of 'Account must be 1-13 digits'

NO positional fallback: a column that cannot be NAMED is refused, never guessed by position - a positional guess on a sheet with one extra leading column pays a real bank account the wrong number behind a green preview
the admin posts the column mapping its preview was built from, so the preview and the generated .201 agree by construction rather than by two recognisers concurring
padLeft() truncates into a fixed-width MASAV slot keeping the LEADING chars, so a 9-digit institutionCode would become a different institution - header settings are bounded before they reach it
